calibration.ISOTONIC_GLOBAL: one monotone map per calibration group; eligible only if preregistered support thresholds are met
calibration.PLATT_ROLE_COMP_RIDGE: logit(q)=a+b*logit(p)+role_intercept+competition_intercept; b>0; role/competition deviations L2-shrunk toward zero. CORNERS_SIDE uses HOME/AWAY role; other groups have no role deviation.

cell_weighting.CORNERS_SIDE: each fixture equal; HOME/AWAY each 50%; lines equal within role
cell_weighting.CORNERS_TOTAL: each fixture equal; total lines equal

calibration.coherence: no line-specific calibrators. Every mapping must be monotone; one selected mapping is applied consistently within a calibration group. Calibrated ladders must be checked monotone after transformation. Raw coherent count distribution is retained separately from calibrated market-event surface.
calibration.selection_rule: candidate must improve Log Loss vs IDENTITY and have Brier <= IDENTITY + tolerance; select minimum Log Loss. If candidates are within LL tie tolerance, select lower-complexity order IDENTITY < PLATT_GLOBAL < BETA_GLOBAL < ISOTONIC_GLOBAL < role/competition ridge.

corners.coherent_mixture: one fixture-level convex mixture weight is applied to the two complete joint count distributions; all side and total event probabilities are marginals of that same joint mixture
corners.component_0: independent Poisson home/away count joint distribution
corners.component_1: independent side-NB2 home/away joint distribution with common DEVELOPMENT-fitted alpha
corners.nonzero_weight_gate: paired weekly-block composite improvement vs w=0 must have 95% CI lower bound >0 for BOTH Log Loss and Brier; HOME and AWAY role Log Loss must not have 95% CI upper bound <0
corners.selection_objective: per-fixture composite proper score: 50% mean SIDE ladder loss + 50% mean TOTAL ladder loss; SIDE itself gives HOME and AWAY equal weight and lines equal weight
corners.selection_rule: among eligible weights choose lowest mean composite Log Loss; tie chooses smaller NB2 weight

goals.blend_contract: blend expected_total; if nonzero diversifier weight is selected, rescale dynamic lambda_home/lambda_away by blended_total/dynamic_total, preserving home/away ratio and a coherent Poisson count distribution
goals.nonzero_weight_gate: paired weekly-block DEVELOPMENT improvement vs w=0 must have 95% CI lower bound >0 for BOTH binary Log Loss and Brier; otherwise select w=0
goals.selection_rule: among eligible weights choose lowest mean binary Log Loss; tie chooses smaller diversifier weight

prediction_support_metadata.ood_policy: diagnostic metadata only in Layer4; it must not silently filter calibration or protected rows. Layer5 may preregister an eligibility policy later.
prediction_support_metadata.reliability_band: weekly-block bootstrap of observed_rate - mean_prediction within fixed raw-probability bin; this is an empirical reliability band, NOT an individual-fixture probability confidence interval

promotion_boundary: Layer4 freezes a standalone odds-blind p_model stack. No market disagreement or profitability claim is allowed. PROTECTED remains sealed until Layer5 market/disagreement policy is also frozen.

scientific_boundary.final_calibrator_refit: selected method refit on all CALIBRATION after selection; resulting fit metrics are descriptive only
scientific_boundary.post_result_redesign: forbidden; material design change requires Layer4 protocol v2 and no reuse of v1 result as confirmatory evidence
